summary: Akanda Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notice of adjourned special meeting of shareholders originally scheduled for March 31, 2026, now rescheduled to May 25, 2026. The meeting was adjourned to satisfy Nasdaq requirements and to bring forward new business. The agenda includes a special resolution to delete Class A and Class B Special Shares from authorized capital, with Class B converting into common shares. No price, premium, or deal terms are stated. The board recommends voting FOR the resolutions. This is a routine procedural filing, not a special situation.
